harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created a LUKS2-encrypted volume (file-backed image at /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img, keyfile at /etc/luks-keys/secure.key, mode 600) on node1, formatted it XFS, mounted it at /srv/secure, and wired /etc/crypttab + /etc/fstab so it auto-unlocks and mounts at boot via systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service and srv-secure.mount. Verified with a live reboot: boot_id changed from 5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc to 9b2d2213-cba2-409e-b416-9a78c3b74a90, and post-reboot the volume was auto-unlocked/mounted with the pre-reboot test file intact and no failed units.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS/disk state (AlmaLinux 9.6, no spare block device)
Installed cryptsetup package
Created 1G backing file /var/lib/secure-volume/secure.img and random keyfile /etc/luks-keys/secure.key (0600)
luksFormat'd the image as LUKS2 using the keyfile
Opened the volume (/dev/mapper/secure), created XFS filesystem, created /srv/secure mountpoint
Added crypttab entry (file-backed, auto-loop) and fstab entry (by UUID) for automatic boot-time unlock+mount
Wrote a test file, closed the volume, reloaded systemd, and manually started systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service and srv-secure.mount to validate the config live
Captured pre-reboot boot_id and unit/mount state as baseline
Issued systemctl reboot on node1 (ack returned before disconnect), polled until reachable again
Verified changed boot_id, confirmed systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service and srv-secure.mount active, /srv/secure mounted, test file present, and no failed units post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Encrypted volume created and mounted at /srv/secure
evidence.summary: Backing file and keyfile created; cryptsetup luksFormat succeeded producing a LUKS2 header; volume opened and formatted XFS

evidence.requirement: Auto-unlock and auto-mount configured for boot
evidence.summary: Added crypttab (file-backed loop) and fstab (UUID) entries; manually started systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service and srv-secure.mount which succeeded and mounted the volume, generator unit confirmed correct Before=local-fs.target ordering
boot_id 5fb1b173-c1c8-4647-b118-0145511f0fcc, systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service and srv-secure.mount active, /srv/secure mounted with 39M used, cryptsetup status active

evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledged and boot identity changed
evidence.summary: systemctl reboot issued (stream closed as node went down = ack), node unreachable during reboot, then reachable again with boot_id 9b2d2213-cba2-409e-b416-9a78c3b74a90 (changed from baseline) and fresh uptime

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of encrypted volume verified
evidence.summary: After reboot, systemd-cryptsetup@secure.service and srv-secure.mount both active automatically, /dev/mapper/secure mounted at /srv/secure, pre-reboot testfile content intact ('hello'), cryptsetup status active, zero failed units
